title: Alarm on AWS spend before anything else changes
description:
**Phase 1 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing, start today
- **Runs in parallel with:** 7c1382, 0ab02c, 272aea, 1ebc7d
- **Unblocks:** nothing, but it covers development for the whole initiative

---
A CfnBudget in CDK with an SNS topic to the owner, plus a hard spend cap on the OpenAI project set by hand in the OpenAI console.

This is a permanent control, not scaffolding. It is the only thing that catches a bug in our own code, which no authentication check ever will.

**Done when:** the budget exists in CDK, a test notification arrives, and the OpenAI cap is set.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Architect ruling: shape decided, one number still needs the human.**

Build it as: an account-level `CfnBudget` with `NOTIFICATIONS_WITH_SUBSCRIBERS` firing at 50, 80, and 100 percent of the monthly figure, plus a forecasted-overage alarm, all to an SNS topic subscribed by the owner. Separately, a hard cap on the OpenAI project set by hand in the OpenAI console, since that is not an AWS resource and cannot be CDK.

**Waiting on the human, not on architecture:** the monthly dollar figure and the notification address. Do not invent one. Build the construct parameterized, land it with a placeholder that fails the deploy if unset rather than a default that silently permits spend, and ask.

The reason this is P0 and first: it is the only control that catches a bug in our own code. Every other control in this initiative stops strangers, and none of them would have stopped us.
